The server admin sends you the code. On pokecio.com you get it at reg@pokecio.com.

At least %1$d characters and at least one symbol like ! ? - _ #. I recommend %2$d or more: 3 to 4 words joined by symbols, for example “blue-hill-morning-coffee”. It must not be the same as the account password.
Add at least one symbol like ! ? - _ #
The phrase is too weak or the same as the account password.
Only this device knows the phrase. The server only gets what is locked with it, not the phrase itself.
The new phrase unlocks the key backup on your other devices. A new recovery key is created at the same time, and the old key and old phrase stop working.
The phrase can only be changed on a verified device with the backup turned on.
At least 8 characters. The password is for signing in, the security phrase protects your messages.

PockyAPP cannot be photographed or recorded and is hidden in the recent apps view. The recovery key, phrase and passwords are always protected.

The PIN cannot be recovered, it is stored only on this device. What remains is to sign out and sign in again. Without a key backup, older encrypted messages on this device are lost.
